localization.source: S2 v139 preregistration unchanged; evaluated separately for each robot

collision.rule: any robot-robot geometry contact with dist_m < 0; episodes merged across gaps <=1 SIM s

deadlock.rule: after startup: reservation state unchanged, another robot waiting, and USING owners stationary (<1cm XY envelope and <5deg yaw range) in final 120 SIM s of that reservation interval; posthoc only
deadlock.additional_lease_rule: Continuous REQUEST >=120 SIM s with the last exclusive owner team stationary (<1cm XY and <5deg yaw in that window); lease epoch renewal/revoke does not reset the waiting interval. Posthoc GT only. Legacy unchanged-state metric retained separately.

delivery.rule: existing S3 post-run referee order completion in zone B, each order separately; pair shared outcome counts one cargo

failure_rule: classify only; same root cause twice stops additional trials
differences_from_s2: all three robots active; idle contacts off
mixed pair beam; loaded pair command model remains separately unqualified
same v3 runtime render binding and controller calibration as S2

references.title: Active Mobile Robot Localization, Burgard et al. IJCAI 1997
references.use: reuse entropy-ranked own-camera observations and uniform global belief; no custom pose prior

references.title: OpenCV homography tutorial
references.use: reuse S2 RGB rotation guard without changing the 90-degree bound

references.title: Gray and Cheriton 1989 leases
references.use: bounded exclusive grants; expiry never implies physical clearance

execution_admission: 14201 only; other catalog seeds are inactive and not authorized by this smoke contract
success: per robot: command completion, at least one posthoc-correct convergence, its cargo delivered B, no own failure or robot collision
heading_dependency: PR422 shared REAL contract plus explicit existing manipulation tolerance

heading_scope.final_alignment: lateral allowed only final 0.10m and registered REAL command
heading_scope.coupled_beam_carry: existing pair continuous lateral schedule, explicit exception; GO remains hard

exact_acceleration.admission: unchanged previously verified v149 posterior cache; saved command/state equality; no threshold/seed changes

would_stop: DEV conservative vetoes log only; actual errors/GO/physical failure stop

options_added.resampling_diversity: off; all three candidates rejected by the unchanged preregistered rule

offline_admission: all implemented stages through native motor stub; zero unexpected errors
return_scope: not implemented; delivery to B unchanged
pre_go_wait: live peer before consumed GO only: would_stop and re-wait; failed GO remains hard
replay_selection_rule: eight trajectories: consistency improves and no RMSE/endpoint deterioration; otherwise off
disk_failure_classification: ENOSPC is HOST_ERROR; preserve raw and do not replace the single admitted attempt
door_lease_geometry: Own commanded v3 arm sphere envelope + chassis; loaded pair union with public beam formation; no peer or GT pose. Formal adds 3sigma XY/yaw chord; DEV logs uncertainty margin and uses nominal own estimate.
